v223-nearby-pois.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle POI tiles scanned offline by production nearby_scan() from the installed CPM5 map bundle (Z5 3x3 inner pass plus Z3 expanding rings), using production remote handlers to add a stop to the itinerary.

v223-secondary-manoeuvre.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle city-centre route calculated by production routing from the installed CPR2 routing graph. Vehicle movement along route vertices is simulated; production nav_maneuver_find() and nav_next_maneuver_find() drive both Turn cards.

v223-view-diversion.gif.routing_provenance: Real Newcastle route and legal alternative geometry from the installed CPR2 routing graph. Historical congestion observations are controlled examples. The production traffic search, shared-geometry rendering, BT CTRL, Explore diversion preview and direct map confirmation handler are used. This is not a claim about actual traffic conditions.
